title: Console API: create/start/stop route experiments + lifecycle state machine
author: Chloe Martin
release_notes:
- Adds Console backend APIs to create/update experiments and transition lifecycle states (start/stop) behind feature flag.
- Standardizes validation error codes/messages for Console UX.
- Adds audit-friendly change summaries in API responses (audit events emitted in follow-up PR).
description:
Implements the initial Console backend surface area for route-level experiments (A/B/n) and a minimal lifecycle state machine that supports safe start/stop semantics. This PR is focused on the Console-facing API layer and request validation/errata so the UI can build against stable contracts.

Key changes:
- Adds REST endpoints for Experiment CRUD + lifecycle transitions:
  - POST /v1/console/experiments (create)
  - GET /v1/console/experiments/{experiment_id}
  - GET /v1/console/experiments?route_id=&state=&limit=&cursor=
  - PATCH /v1/console/experiments/{experiment_id} (mutable fields while DRAFT)
  - POST /v1/console/experiments/{experiment_id}:start
  - POST /v1/console/experiments/{experiment_id}:stop
- Introduces a server-side lifecycle state machine (persisted) with explicit transition validation.
- Defines start/stop semantics, including a short “draining” state to avoid flapping during propagation.
- Adds structured validation errors (stable error codes + field paths) for Console UX.
- Gates mutations behind feature flag `route_experiments_console_api` (account-level allowlist) and RBAC permission checks (final permission matrix in ENG-9029 follow-up).

Lifecycle states (initial):
- DRAFT: editable; not evaluated by policy engine.
- RUNNING: experiment is eligible for assignment; config is published.
- STOPPING: stop requested; router/policy will stop assigning; existing in-flight requests may continue; transitions to STOPPED when publish completes.
- STOPPED: not eligible; immutable except deletion/archival (archival not in this PR).

Transition rules:
- DRAFT -> RUNNING (start)
- RUNNING -> STOPPING (stop)
- STOPPING -> STOPPED (async completion after publish)
- STOPPED -> RUNNING (re-start) is NOT allowed in this PR (requires new experiment for audit clarity; can revisit)

Validation + error model:
- Server validates allocations sum to 1.0, variant IDs uniqueness, and required routing fields (route_id + stickiness policy) with human-readable errors.
- Adds stable error codes for Console to map to inline form errors:
  - EXPERIMENT_INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION
  - EXPERIMENT_INVALID_ALLOCATION
  - EXPERIMENT_VARIANT_DUPLICATE
  - EXPERIMENT_ROUTE_NOT_FOUND
  - EXPERIMENT_FEATURE_FLAG_DISABLED
  - EXPERIMENT_FORBIDDEN
  - EXPERIMENT_CONFLICT_OVERLAPPING (stubbed; enforced in ENG-9021 validation PR; for now returns warning header if overlaps detected by best-effort query)

Notes / out of scope:
- Audit event emission is wired in PR-28539; this PR only returns a change summary suitable for audit logs.
- Guardrail evaluation + auto-stop in PR-28567/28581.
- Results API is separate (PR-28644).

Testing:
- Unit tests for transition validation and request schemas.
- Integration tests for start/stop idempotency and RBAC gating.

Rollout:
- Feature-flagged. Intended for internal + beta accounts only.
- Includes explicit “kill switch” path returning FEATURE_FLAG_DISABLED for mutations when disabled.

Screenshots: N/A (backend only)

Follow-ups:
- Align overlap policy enforcement with ADR precedence decision (experiment vs canary) once evaluator order lands (PR-28457).
- Add explicit STOPPING -> STOPPED publish status plumbing from control-plane publisher (currently simulated with a background job in Console backend).

review_conversation: Dylan Brooks (review): Can we make stop idempotent? UI will retry on 5xx/timeouts; I want stop to return 200 with current state if already STOPPING/STOPPED. Also please document whether STOPPING is user-visible.

Chloe Martin (author): Updated stop handler to accept idempotency key + treat STOPPING/STOPPED as success. STOPPING is returned in API response and intended to be shown as an intermediate state in Console (design has this as “Stopping…”).
Jada Williams (review): State model looks fine. One concern: you disallow STOPPED->RUNNING restart. Is that aligned with product? (Some customers expect pause/resume.)

Chloe Martin (author): Confirmed with Marissa: for beta/GA we prefer ‘create a new experiment’ for restart to preserve audit clarity + avoid ambiguous results windows. Added note in description and explicit error code EXPERIMENT_INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION.

Ethan Park (review): The publish job stub worries me. We need to avoid lying about propagation. Can we at least expose a publish_status field so Console can show ‘pending’ and we can wire real signals later?

Chloe Martin (author): Added publish_status={PENDING|PUBLISHED|FAILED} and last_publish_at. Right now background job sets PUBLISHED; follow-up will connect to control-plane publisher events. Also added TODOs + test coverage for status transitions.
Kaitlyn Nguyen (review): RBAC: which permission are you checking? Please don’t use a generic admin check. We need a named permission so we can map to enterprise roles.

Chloe Martin (author): Added `console.experiments.write` and `console.experiments.read` checks (namespacing consistent with existing rollouts permissions). Kept the mapping minimal; ENG-9029 will finalize role bindings.
Sean Gallagher (review): Please ensure feature flag disable path is explicit and observable. Also add metrics for start/stop calls and failure reasons (at least error code).

Chloe Martin (author): Added `console_experiments_mutation_blocked_total{reason=feature_flag|rbac}` and `console_experiments_transition_total{transition=...}` counters with error_code tag. Verified cardinality is bounded.
Dylan Brooks (review): Minor: Error payload should include field path for allocations (e.g., variants[1].allocation). UI needs that. Also can we standardize on snake_case for error_code fields?
Chloe Martin (author): Done: error response includes `errors[].field` with JSON pointer-ish paths and `errors[].code` in SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE to match other Console APIs.
Dylan Brooks (review): Approved once CI is green.
Sean Gallagher (review): Approved (with follow-up to wire publish_status to real propagation signal).
merge_outcome: Merged into main via squash. Deployed to staging in release-2025-02-28 train behind feature flag `route_experiments_console_api`.
